name: software_pecan
description: PECAN (pose classification, PECAN/MILAN pose-classification / binding-affinity repo): PyTorch + PyTorch-Geometric EGNN DDP training on PDBspheres/PDBBind HDF5 shards, traced and optimized with dftracer on Tuolumne (MI300A, ROCm 6.3.1, Flux). Holds the venv/build recipe (python/3.11.5 for ROCm torch wheels, torch_scatter/torch_sparse with PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=gfx942 and plain GCC for torch_sparse), dataset permission workarounds, app bug fixes, the flux DDP launch and dftracer_service recipe, DataLoader worker tracing (spawn, worker_init_fn finalize), and every measured optimization result. Load for any PECAN / PDBspheres / PDBBind session, or on 'undefined symbol: _cray$mt_kmpc_fork_call_with_flags', 'Per-resource options can't be used with per-task options', a silent hung NCCL/RCCL rendezvous, 'flux run dftracer_service start' never returning, 'GLIBCXX_3.4.32 not found' with LD_PRELOAD, 0-byte DataLoader worker .pfw.gz files, 'Can't pickle local object ... _worker_init', a num_workers>2 deadlock, or 'ValueError: not enough values to unpack (expected 7, got 6)'.
